What is the best description of the meaning of the ‘mass’ of an object?
A
the space occupied by the object
B
the force that gravity exerts on the object
C
the resistance of the object to changes in motion
D
the closeness of packing of the molecules in the object

options.label: A
options.text: the space occupied by the object

options.text: the force that gravity exerts on the object
